proof_body:
by
  intro f hf hr z
  have hd : Differentiable ℂ (fun w => (starRingEnd ℂ) (f ((starRingEnd ℂ) w))) := by
    intro w
    have h : HasDerivAt f (deriv f ((starRingEnd ℂ) w)) ((starRingEnd ℂ) w) := (hf _).hasDerivAt
    have h2 := h.conj_conj
    simp only [Complex.conj_conj] at h2
    exact h2.differentiableAt
  have hfa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f Set.univ := (Complex.analyticOnNhd_univ_iff_differentiable).mpr hf
  have hga : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun w => (starRingEnd ℂ) (f ((starRingEnd ℂ) w))) Set.univ := (Complex.analyticOnNhd_univ_iff_differentiable).mpr hd
  have heq : f = fun w => (starRingEnd ℂ) (f ((starRingEnd ℂ) w)) := by
    have ht : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) := by
      refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => ?_)⟩
      · have := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)
        have h2 := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp this
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using h2
      · simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, inv_eq_zero]
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero n : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0)
    have hfr : ∃ᶠ w in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {0}ᶜ, f w = (starRingEnd ℂ) (f ((starRingEnd ℂ) w)) := by
      refine ht.frequently (Filter.Frequently.of_forall (fun n => ?_))
      have hx := hr (((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹)
      have hc : (starRingEnd ℂ) (f (((((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = f (((((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ : ℝ)) : ℂ) := Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr hx
      have e : (((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ : ℂ) = (((((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ : ℝ)) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
      rw [e, Complex.conj_ofReal, hc]
    exact AnalyticOnNhd.eq_of_frequently_eq hfa hga hfr
  have := congrFun heq ((starRingEnd ℂ) z)
  simpa using this
